name: isFreeOfPHP2ShellFindings
definition: True when the customer's vulnerability scanner, read whole and recently, holds no open finding for CVE-2026-109618 or CVE-2026-109619 (PHP2Shell, PHP core, fixed in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35, published 2026-10-21), and the read itself shows the scanner's PHP2Shell detections reached the tenant and assessed the assets on-host. False when any open or reopened finding for either CVE exists.
population: vulnerability records for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 that the customer's scanner holds; for CrowdStrike Falcon Spotlight, every record of GET /spotlight/combined/vulnerabilities/v1 filtered by those two cve.id values, any status
evidenceRequiredForTrue: CrowdStrike Falcon Spotlight: a complete, untruncated, error-free read of the cve.id-filtered combined vulnerabilities endpoint whose meta.pagination.total equals the records read, with no repeated id; at least one record (an empty answer cannot show the PHP2Shell detections reached the tenant); every record for one of the two CVEs, status closed (none open, reopen or expired), updated_timestamp on or after 2026-10-21T00:00:00Z, and host_info.managed_by 'Falcon sensor' (on-host assessment).

changeLog.change: Registered with the CrowdStrike Falcon Spotlight PHP2Shell transform; proposed, no requirement reads it yet.

notes: Threat-specific (PHP2Shell advisory, October 2026). The supporting field php2shellRiskLevel is high when an affected asset is marked internet-facing by the vendor, standard when every affected asset is marked not internet-facing, unknown otherwise, none when clean. An empty filtered read is Not evaluated, not compliant: the scanner gives no field saying which CVEs its content covers. A read limited to the assets the scanner knows cannot show every web host is covered; hosts with no sensor and no other data provider are outside it. allowedCategories is empty until Integration-Service maps an RTA row.
